plugins.readme_text: # dsh-zoom-viewer A zoomable image viewer for the **DSH** right sidebar. It registers its own image renderer with the host's document-preview registry, so any image opened in the sidebar gets real navigation instead of a static ``: - **Wheel zoom anchored at the pointer** — Ctrl+wheel or a trackpad pinch uses a finer step; range 5%–1600% - **Drag to pan**, with the viewport scrollbars kept in sync - **Double-click to reset** to the fitted view - **Fullscreen overlay** for the current image, closed with Esc or the 退出全屏 button - **Toolbar**: `−` / percentage / `+` / 适应 (fit) / 宽 (fit width) / `1:1` / 全屏 ![The viewer in the DSH sidebar: the tab, the active renderer label 缩放图片 and the viewed image](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/1378616343/dsh-zoom-viewer/main/docs/screenshot.png) ## Install ```bash # the DSH CLI — use --profile desktop for the desktop app dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-zoom-viewer # no dsh on PATH? run the CLI through npx npx -p @deepseek-ai/dsh dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-zoom-viewer # or straight from this repository instead of npm npx -p @deepseek-ai/dsh dsh plugin --profile web add github:1378616343/dsh-zoom-viewer ``` The same thing from the DSH UI: **插件 / Plugins** page → the arrow menu → **安装第三方插件 / Install third-party plugin**, then paste `dsh-zoom-viewer`, this repository's URL, or the local directory containing `package.json`. **Restart DSH afterwards** — the plugin tree is only read at startup. ### From a plugin-market index source The Plugins page also accepts an **索引源 / index source**. This repository ships one (format 1, validated against DSH's own `@deepseek-ai/dsh-plugin-market-index`): ``` https://raw.githubusercontent.com/1378616343/dsh-zoom-viewer/main/market/index.json ``` The entry then appears under **Discover** and installs with one click. Regenerate and re-validate it with: ```bash node tool/build-market-index.mjs --repo https://github.com/1378616343/dsh-zoom-viewer ``` ## Compatibility - Targets the host document-preview registry (`documentPreviews` plus the `sidebar.right.tab.document` slot) of **DSH desktop 0.2.1-rc.2**, and registers *above* the built-in image renderer, so it becomes the default for `png jpg jpeg gif webp bmp ico svg`. A file whose extension lies about its content is still matched, by magic-number sniffing. - No build step and no runtime dependencies: `lib/client.js` is a prebuilt browser module, and `react` / `react-dom` are taken from the host's module table. - Declares no `engines.dsh` range and no `@deepseek-ai/dsh*` peer dependency, so the plugin manager's compatibility gate never refuses it. `react` is an optional peer only. ## Permissions Nothing of its own: no network requests, no filesystem access, no install scripts. The viewer renders the bytes the host hands it and keeps to its own CSS class prefix. ## Uninstall Plugins page → remove the entry → restart DSH. ## Layout | File | Role | |---|---| | `lib/client.js` | Browser half: the renderer definition and the zoom / pan implementation (single file, no build) | | `lib/index.js` | Host half: an empty plugin, existing so the bundle is manageable from the profile | | `cordis.patch.yml` | The bundle's load row | | `locale/*.json` | Renderer name and UI strings (en / zh) | | `market/index.json` | Plugin-market index, format 1 | | `tool/build-market-index.mjs` | Generates and validates that index | | `docs/screenshot.png` | The screenshot above | | `NOTES.md` | Design and evidence notes (which host extension point, and why the third-party viewer API cannot be used) | | `DISTRIBUTION.md` | Install and publish runbook | ## License MIT — see [LICENSE](LICENSE). ## 中文说明 为 DSH 右侧栏里的图片加上真正的查看器：以光标为锚点的滚轮缩放（5%–1600%，Ctrl+滚轮 / 触控板双指更细）、 按住拖拽平移、双击复位，工具栏提供 `−` 百分比 `+` 适应 宽 `1:1` 全屏（Esc 退出）。它注册到宿主的图片预览注册表并排在内建 渲染器之前，所以 `png jpg jpeg gif webp bmp ico svg` 默认由它接管。 安装：`dsh plugin --profile desktop add dsh-zoom-viewer`（或插件页的「安装第三方插件」），**装完要重启 DSH**。 本插件不发网络请求、不读写文件、不带安装脚本，`lib/client.js` 是预构建产物，无需 npm install 之外的任何步骤。

plugins.description: Photo-real desk pet plugin for DeepSeek Harness: four personas, expressions + actions, proactive speech, neural TTS, tiny chat box that never touches your session.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-pet

A little companion that lives in the bottom-right corner of the **DSH web UI**: it stays
around or drops in at random, talks (with voice), walks, dances, gets shy or annoyed, and
carries a tiny input box you can chat with. Four photo-realistic personas, each with its
own temper.

> Scope: the pet only lives inside the DSH window (it mounts into the framework's overlay
> slot). It **cannot float above other applications** — that would need a separate Electron
> shell rather than a plugin.

## At a glance

- **Languages**: UI chrome, persona taglines and the chat system prompt follow the browser
  interface language — shipped for `en / zh / es / pt / hi` (`locale/*.json`, namespace
  `pet`; slots register with `locale: 'pet'` per the DSH slot contract). Each persona also
  ships an English line pack, so a non-Chinese UI hears English lines.

- **Mount points**: `shell.overlay` (the pet itself, a click-through layer) and
  `conversation.input.right` (the entry button next to the composer).
- **Private chat**: what you type in the small box **never enters your session**. The host
  half exposes `POST /dsh-pet/chat` and answers with a one-shot `ctx.llm.stream()` call
  (no session, no session log). Defaults: `deepseek-account` / `deepseek-flash`; provider,
  model, maxTokens and temperature are plugin config.
- **Icon**: `icon.svg` (the rose silhouette) and the composer button share the same path.
- **Settings panel**: grouped (look / voice / display / actions / effects), custom dropdowns
  (native `<select>` popups are system-white and unreadable in dark themes) and custom
  switches; it is pinned to the viewport and does not follow the pet.
- **Four personas** (photo-realistic, same lighting, 5 expressions each: default / happy /
  shy / angry / sleepy): 薇 (violet), 绯 (crimson), 靛 (indigo), 雪 (silver).
  Expression changes cross-fade (240 ms) instead of hard-cutting.
- **Action sequences**: a persona may declare `actions: { dance: [...], hair: [...],
  walk: [...] }`; each set is 3 frames played as a 340 ms flip-book. All four have dance /
  hair-flip / walk, each stylised to the character.
- **Adding artwork**: drop transparent PNGs into `assets/` and reference them from
  `PERSONAS` (`image`, or `images: { mood: 'file.png' }`). Served by `/dsh-pet/assets/`
  (image extensions only, basename only). `tools/make-pet-image.py` removes a green-screen
  background (preferred) and falls back to a gradient key.

## Behavior

| Capability | How |
|---|---|
| Always-on / random | Toggle in the panel; random mode rolls a per-hour probability inside the active window |
| Active hours | Start/end time, supports crossing midnight (22:00 → 03:00) |
| Proactive lines | Per-mood line packs, bubble + speech |
| Voice | **Optional**: if the host has any python with `edge-tts`, `/dsh-pet/tts` synthesises (cached) and `/dsh-pet/tts/status` probes it; otherwise it falls back to the system `speechSynthesis`. The plugin itself has zero runtime dependencies |
| Small input box | Chat with the pet only; one-shot model call, nothing is written to any DSH session |
| Moods | idle / walk / dance / shy / angry / sleep / talk / happy |
| Gaze | Pupils follow the mouse (CSS variables only, no re-render) |
| Effects | Ink / confetti / cloud / fog (wipable) / bomb + cracked screen |
| Event hooks | Confetti after a turn longer than 4 s; a cloud appears after a failed tool call |
| Temper | Per-persona weight table decides what it does more of |
| Hide | "Hide for 1 h" in the panel |

## Install (local, no registry)

Published as `dsh-pet-plugin` on npm; it also installs straight from a folder.

```bash
# from the registry (after publish)
dsh plugin --profile desktop add dsh-pet-plugin
```

```powershell
# from a local checkout: quit DSH first, then
powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File .\install.ps1    # or double-click install.cmd
```

Quit DSH first (the profile's `package.json` is HMR-watched). The script adds
`"dsh-pet-plugin": "file:<this dir>"` to the profile, registers the bundle, runs
`pnpm install`, then reads back all four facts. `update.cmd` only refreshes files and is
safe while DSH is running. For the sweeter neural voice:

```bash
pip install edge-tts                     # any python the host can find
export DSH_PET_PYTHON=/path/to/python    # only if auto-discovery misses it
```

## Verify

```bash
node --check client.js
node tests/smoke.mjs                     # fake window + React stub, renders every persona/mood
# host routes need the harness packages, so run them from the installed copy:
cd <profile>/node_modules/dsh-pet-plugin && node --test tests/host.test.mjs
node <dsh-plugin-guide>/bin/dsh-plugin-dev.js check --cwd . --strict
node <dsh-plugin-guide>/bin/dsh-plugin-dev.js verify --cwd .
```

## Customize

- **The client bundle is generated**: edit `src/*.js` and run `node build.mjs`, which
  concatenates the parts into `client.js` (the only file DSH loads). Never edit
  `client.js` by hand — `npm test` rebuilds and then runs the smoke test.
- **Personas, lines and tempers**: `pets/<id>/pack.json` — `images` (five
  expressions), `actions` (dance / hair / walk, three frames each), `voice`, `temper`,
  and `lines` / `linesEn` line packs.
- **UI strings**: edit the `pet` namespace in `locale/*.json`, then `node build.mjs` — the
  dictionaries are injected at build time, so the locale files are the single source of
  truth. New language: run `node tools/gen-locales.cjs` for a skeleton, then translate.
- **Moods and animations**: add keyframes in `src/70-style.js` and map the class by `mood`
  in `src/96-overlay.js`.
- **Action clips**: a pack may carry `clips: { dance: "pet-x-dance.webm" }` — a VP9 WebM with an
  alpha channel. When that action plays the pet renders a looping `<video>` instead of
  flipping through still frames, which is the only way to get true 24 fps motion.
- **Artwork**: drop transparent WebPs into `assets/` and reference them from
  `pets/<id>/pack.json`, then `node build.mjs` (it regenerates `src/30-personas.js`).
  The `/dsh-pet/assets/` route only serves image extensions.

## Security model

- The host routes are gated three ways, none of them tied to a fixed port or domain:
  `Host` must be a loopback address, the host's own origin, or listed in the
  `allowedHosts` plugin config (for reverse-proxy / LAN deployments); a present
  `Origin` must be same-origin with that `Host` or the desktop shell
  (`dsh-app://app`, `dsh-app://shell`); and `Sec-Fetch-Site`, when present, must be
  `same-origin` or `none`. Non-browser clients that send none of these are allowed —
  that is the deliberate limit of a local HTTP endpoint, see below.
- Speech synthesis is a `POST` endpoint that returns the audio bytes; there is no
  GET URL to feed to an `<audio src>`, so a page (or another local process) cannot make
  the host synthesise anything by pointing an element at it.
- Synthesised speech is cached in the OS temp dir with a size cap that is re-checked
  after every synthesis, and writes go through a random temp name + rename so a
  pre-planted symlink cannot redirect them.
- Anything the page sends (settings, chat history, persona id) is treated as data:
  validated, length-capped, and never interpolated as instructions or markup.
- Neural voice sends the spoken text to Microsoft's edge-tts endpoint. Turn it off
  (or never install `edge-tts`) to keep everything local; the panel says so.

## Known limits

- **Host version**: built and tested against dsh `0.2.1-alpha.2`. It needs the
  `webServer` service and the `shell.overlay` / `conversation.input.right` slots, which
  are 0.2-generation APIs — on a 0.1.x host it installs but never mounts (one console line
  says so). `engines.dsh` in `package.json` is a declaration only: the installer does not
  enforce it, and the plugin declares no `@deepseek-ai/dsh-*` peer ranges on purpose, so a
  version mismatch never blocks installation.


- Neural voice needs a host python with `edge_tts`; otherwise the system SAPI voice is used.
- Browsers block autoplay before the first user gesture — click the page once.
- Settings live in `localStorage`. The debug handle (`globalThis._

plugins.description: Preview Blender .blend files in the DeepSeek Harness right Sidebar: cached headless GLB export plus a dependency-free WebGL viewer with scene statistics.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-blend-preview

Preview Blender **`.blend`** files inside [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai): the right-Sidebar document preview turns the scene into an interactive 3D viewport (orbit / zoom / wireframe) with a scene-information panel, instead of the built-in “binary file, no preview” empty state.

![The preview inside the DSH right Sidebar](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/439436269-ctrl/dsh-blend-preview/main/docs/blender-preview.png)

## What it does

- Registers a document-preview renderer for `.blend` files, so clicking one in **Workspace files** opens it in the right Sidebar.
- Runs `blender --background` once per file version to export a **GLB** plus a scene JSON (objects, triangles, materials, real-world size in mm, units, cameras, lights, collections).
- Draws the GLB with a small **dependency-free WebGL viewer** written for this plugin: orbit, pan, wheel zoom, double-click reset, wireframe mode, auto-rotate, a soft contact shadow and an axis triad. No CDN, no three.js.
- Caches conversions under `~/.dsh/cache/blend-preview`; the second open is instant (a few milliseconds).
- Shows the scene facts that matter for CAD/3D-printing work: per-object triangle counts and bounding-box sizes in millimetres, material swatches, scene units.

## Requirements

- DeepSeek Harness 0.2.x (declared compatible with `0.2.0-rc.2` and `0.2.1-rc.2`).
- **Blender 3.6 / 4.x / 5.x** installed. The plugin auto-detects `DSH_BLENDER`, `BLENDER_PATH`, `blender` on `PATH`, the Steam library, and `C:\Program Files\Blender Foundation\Blender*`. Set `blenderPath` if your install lives elsewhere.
- A browser/GPU with WebGL (the DSH desktop app always has it).

## Install

```sh
# into a normal (non-desktop) profile
dsh plugin --profile <profile> add dsh-blend-preview

# the desktop profile is owned by the Electron app; add it there through the
# plugin manager UI, or compose it manually and restart the app
```

The package ships a `cordis.patch.yml`, so installation adds the plugin row automatically. Restart DSH after installing.

## Configuration

Settings → Plugins → **Blender preview** (namespace `blend-preview`):

| Key | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `enabled` | `true` | Register the renderer and the conversion route. |
| `routePath` | `/api/blend-preview` | Authenticated conversion route. Must stay under `/api`; otherwise the authenticated fence is bypassed, so it falls back to the default. |
| `extensions` | `["blend"]` | Suffixes that open in the 3D preview. |
| `blenderPath` | `""` (auto) | Absolute path of `blender.exe` / `blender`. |
| `cacheDir` | `""` → `~/.dsh/cache/blend-preview` | Where exported GLB files and scene JSON live. |
| `timeoutMs` | `180000` | Wall-clock ceiling for one cold conversion. |
| `maxBytes` | `1073741824` | Largest `.blend` converted (1 GiB). |
| `applyModifiers` | `true` | Apply modifiers during export, so the preview matches what Blender renders. |
| `cacheEntries` | `24` | Cached conversions kept on disk before the oldest are pruned. |

## How it works

```
Workspace file click
        │
        ▼
document preview body (lib/client.js)
        │  GET /api/blend-preview?path=…&kind=info   (scene JSON)
        │  GET /api/blend-preview?path=…&kind=glb    (model bytes)
        ▼
Host half (lib/index.js, lib/route.js)
        │  cache key = sha1(realpath, size, mtime, recipe, modifiers)
        ▼
lib/blender.js ── spawn blender --background --python lib/scene.py
        │            → model.glb + scene.json (+ meta.json)
        ▼
~/.dsh/cache/blend-preview/<key>/
```

- `lib/scene.py` exports with `export_apply`, `use_visible`, **Y-up**, no cameras/lights, and writes the scene description (world-space AABBs through the evaluated depsgraph, Principled base colours converted to sRGB swatches).
- The route lives under `/api`, so the connection service authenticates every request (Host/Origin fence + session cookie). Arbitrary local files are not exposed.
- The viewer is a hand-written glTF 2.0 subset renderer (POSITION + NORMAL, indexed triangles, PBR factors, node TRS/matrix). Textures, skinning and animation are out of scope; the Host only exports still scenes.

## Development

```
dev/client-body.js   client UI (single CJS factory for the DSH module loader)
dev/viewer.js        the WebGL renderer, spliced into the bundle at build time
scripts/build-client.mjs   builds lib/client.js from the two files
scripts/e2e-browser.mjs    Playwright end-to-end against a temporary DSH host
scripts/live-selftest.mjs  cold/warm/concurrent conversion against a real .blend
node --test test/*.test.js
```

`lib/client.js` is generated — edit the files under `dev/` and rebuild. The DSH client loader hands the bundle a `require` limited to the platform seed modules, so the package cannot pull a renderer dependency at runtime; the single generated file is the intended shape.

## Notes and limits

- A cold conversion takes roughly 2–10 s for a small scene (Blender startup dominates); it is cached per file version, so rotating/zooming never re-runs Blender.
- Very large scenes (millions of triangles) export slowly and may exceed `timeoutMs`.
- Textures are not shown in the viewport (base colours only); the Blender renders next to the file are still the reference.
- Nothing is uploaded: Blender runs locally and the GLB stays in the local cache.

plugins.description: Conversation turn rail for the DSH Web UI: one tick per user message, hover to preview, click to jump, plus a scroll-position indicator. 会话左侧刻度滑轨：悬停预览、点击跳转。
plugins.readme_text:
对话长了以后，回到「某一个问题的位置」不该靠运气。
一列刻度，悬停看当时问了什么，点一下跳过去。

English · 中文

## 先看效果

悬停任意刻度 → 变长、上下相邻两根略长；卡片显示轮次与提问原文。

最左侧细进度条：拖拽或点击按比例跳转。

## 它解决什么 长会话里，`Ctrl+F` 是找词，不是找位置。想回到三步之前那个问题，只能一路往上滚，或者反复点「加载更早」翻到眼熟为止。 **dsh-turn-rail** 在对话区左缘放一列短横线：**一条线 = 你发出的一个问题**。悬停看到当时问了什么，点击直接过去。它只做这一件事——不加设置项，不加面板，不加后台任务。 ### 四个细节 | | | |---|---| | **目标不在当前页也能跳** | 历史是虚拟列表，翻走了的节点不在 DOM 里。点击时它会驱动宿主自己的「加载更早」把那一页翻回来，再定位过去（预算 6 秒，按钮消失即认定历史到头） | | **同一句话发两次也不会跳错** | 定位用的是消息锚点 `data-chat-anchor-key`，不是文本匹配 | | **知道你在哪** | 你正在看的那一轮始终是蓝色长刻度，随滚动实时移动 | | **不挡字** | 刻度压到正文时自动向左让位（最多 14px），退无可退才隐藏 | ## 安装 ```sh dsh plugin --profile web add https://github.com/shrekcg/dsh-turn-rail ``` 装完 **硬刷新浏览器**（Cmd/Ctrl + Shift + R）。 > `web` 换成你自己的 profile 名，桌面版通常是 `desktop`。 ## 为什么它这么轻 这个插件的核心约束是**不被宿主替掉**。 DSH 里做同类功能的插件大多走「客户端 `inject: [..., 'remote']` → RPC 读会话日志」这条路。0.2.x 的客户端 API 换过一轮，那条路整体失效——表现是插件装好了、页面上什么都没有。 `dsh-turn-rail` 只依赖两样在 UI 层长期稳定的东西： ```text [data-conversation-scroll] 对话滚动视口 [data-chat-flow-kind="user"|"steering"] 你发出的提问节点 ``` 分页复用宿主自己的「加载更早」按钮，不自己读日志、不自己发请求。没有宿主服务依赖、没有后台进程、没有设置面板、没有任何存储。 ## 边界 - 只在 Web GUI 的「对话」视图渲染，切到轨迹 / 子代理视图自动隐藏。 - 被宿主压缩（compaction）掉的历史不在 DOM 里，刻度也不会包含——不伪造历史。 - 若宿主未来改动上面两个 DOM 契约，刻度会整体不显示（安静失败，不影响对话）。修复点集中在 [`lib/client.js`](./lib/client.js) 顶部的 `SEL` 常量。 ## 项目结构 ```text dsh-turn-rail/ ├── package.json # dsh.bundle + dsh.client 清单 ├── cordis.patch.yml # 挂载到 profile 的一行 ├── index.js # 宿主端：空实现（滑轨完全在浏览器侧） ├── lib/client.js # 全部逻辑：样式、布局、悬停、跳转、进度 └── assets/readme/ # 封面与截图 ``` 没有构建步骤：`lib/client.js` 就是最终产物（`__ModuleLoader__.load` bundle 格式）。 ```sh git clone https://github.com/shrekcg/dsh-turn-rail dsh plugin --profile web add link:./dsh-turn-rail # 改 lib/client.js，重启 DSH 即生效 ``` ## License [MIT](./LICENSE) © 2026 shrek wu · English version: [`README.en.md`](./README.en.md)

plugins.description: Screenshot capture for the DSH composer: region capture and hide-window capture from the + menu, landing in the chat input as an image attachment.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-screenshot-chat

A DeepSeek Harness plugin that adds a **Screenshot** entry to the chat composer's **`+` menu**, so a region captured on your Mac lands in the input box as an image attachment.

## Features

- **One-click region capture** — opens the native macOS selection overlay (the same one as `⇧⌘4`), and the selected region arrives in the current conversation's composer as an **image attachment**, ready to send with your next message. Pressing `Esc` or right-clicking cancels silently.
- **Hide-window capture** — hover the *Screenshot* row and a small toggle appears on the right (`○ Hide window`). Turn it on and the window that is frontmost when you click is hidden first, then the selection overlay appears; when the capture finishes or is cancelled, the window is restored and brought back to the front.
- **Mode is remembered** — the toggle state is stored in `localStorage` and survives page reloads. While it is on, the menu item's description also shows the active mode, so you can see it without hovering.
- **Platform-aware** — the menu entry is hidden automatically on platforms without `screencapture` (anything other than macOS).

## Install

```bash
dsh plugin add dsh-screenshot-chat
```

Then restart DeepSeek Harness (or reload the web client) so the bundle is composed.

### Local development

Point a profile at a checkout instead of the published package:

```json
{
  "dependencies": {
    "dsh-screenshot-chat": "link:/absolute/path/to/dsh-screenshot"
  },
  "dsh": { "profile": { "bundles": ["...", "dsh-screenshot-chat"] } }
}
```

Run `pnpm install` in the profile. With HMR enabled, config changes apply immediately; otherwise restart DSH. Host-side edits (`index.js`) take effect after touching the profile's `cordis.patch.yml` (any change re-composes the tree without a restart); client-side edits (`client.js`) are hot-replaced by the client HMR poll.

## Usage

1. Click **`+` → Screenshot** in the composer.
2. Drag to select a region on screen.
3. The capture appears in the composer as an image attachment — send it as usual.

To capture without the DSH window in the shot, hover the menu entry, switch on **Hide window**, then click *Screenshot*. The window disappears during selection and comes back afterwards.

## Configuration

Override the defaults from your profile patch, keyed by the plugin id:

```yaml
- id: dsh-screenshot-chat
  name: 'dsh-screenshot-chat'
  config:
    timeoutMs: 180000   # how long the region selection may stay open
```

## How it works

### Host side (`index.js`)

Registers same-origin routes under `/.dsh-screenshot` on the host web server:

- `POST /capture` with body `{ "hide": true | false }`
  - Runs `screencapture -i -x -o <tempfile>`, waits for the selection, then returns the PNG as base64 and deletes the temp file immediately. A cancelled selection returns `{ cancelled: true }`.
  - With `hide: true` it first resolves the **frontmost process name** through AppleScript (System Events) and hides it (the equivalent of `⌘H`, with a system-level denylist — Finder, Dock, System Settings and friends are never hidden), waits for the hide animation to settle (350 ms), then captures. A `finally` block restores and re-focuses the window whether the capture succeeded, was cancelled, or timed out.
- `GET /health` lets the browser half probe platform support (the entry is hidden off macOS).

Only one capture may run at a time. A capture that stays open longer than `timeoutMs` (default 180 s) is terminated, and `osascript` calls time out after 60 s.

### Browser side (`client.js`)

Contributes a `screenshot` command to the `+` menu through `commandUi.register` (`kind: 'action'`, so a click runs the current mode). A document-level `mouseover` delegate spots the menu row carrying the `data-dsc-icon` marker and mounts the hover toggle inside it, using native listeners and inline styles so it does not depend on the menu component's internal class names. `mousedown` and `click` on the toggle stop propagation so the row is not selected.

The returned image is wrapped in a `File` and handed to `conversation.createDrafts` plus the composer's `addFiles` — the exact same attachment path as pasting an image, so previews, size limits, and upload encoding all run through the host's existing logic.

## Permissions (macOS)

1. **Screen Recording** — the first capture may prompt for authorization, or grant it under **System Settings → Privacy & Security → Screen Recording** for the app running the DSH host. Without it, captures can come out as wallpaper only.
2. **Automation** (hide-window capture only) — hiding and restoring the window uses System Events, so macOS asks to allow controlling System Events on first use; the same switch lives under **System Settings → Privacy & Security → Automation**. Denying it leaves plain region capture working; hide-window capture shows an authorization hint instead.

## Limitations

- Interactive region selection relies on macOS `screencapture -i`, so the plugin works on macOS only; the menu entry hides itself elsewhere.
- Capture runs on the Mac hosting the DSH process, not on the machine running the browser. For a local deployment these are the same machine.
- *Hide window* hides whichever app is frontmost at the moment you click. If you switch to another app immediately after clicking, that app is the one hidden.

## License

MIT

plugins.description: One-click upgrades, version history and rollback for plugins on the DeepSeek Harness Plugins page
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-plugin-upgrader

[![npm](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/dsh-plugin-upgrader.svg)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-plugin-upgrader)
[![license](https://img.shields.io/npm/l/dsh-plugin-upgrader.svg)](./LICENSE)

> 给 DeepSeek Harness（DSH）的「插件」页补上**一键升级**和**版本历史 / 回滚**。

DSH 自带的插件页能装、能卸、能看已安装列表，但缺两件事：一次把全部插件升到最新，以及退回某个旧版本。
这个插件在插件页里加一个「版本」标签，把这两件事补齐。

[English](./README.en.md) · 中文

![版本标签](./screenshots/history.png)

## 功能

- **一键升级** —— 一次把全部可升级插件升到最新版，带进度、逐项结果和失败原因。
- **多选升级** —— 勾选任意几个插件，只升级选中的这些。
- **版本历史 / 回滚** —— 展开任意插件即可看到已发布的全部版本（含发布时间与引擎要求），点一下切到那个版本。
- **一键跳 GitHub** —— 每行的 `GH` 按钮打开插件仓库主页；点版本号直接进该版本的 GitHub 发布页。

## 界面位置

插件页顶部标签栏多出一个「版本」标签，与「已安装」「发现」并列：

- 顶部统计：可升级数量 / 已安装数量 / 每个插件的版本数
- 「一键升级」升全部可升级插件；下面一条选择栏负责「升级选中」
- 「检查更新」强制刷新 registry 缓存（默认缓存 5 分钟）
- 搜索框按包名过滤
- 每个插件一行，展开「历史 (n)」后是该插件的完整版本列表
- `GH` 打开仓库主页（没有仓库的插件不显示该按钮）
- 版本列表里每个版本号本身就是链接，点开直接进 GitHub 的发布页：
  - 该版本打过 tag → `releases/tag/v<version>`（tag 是否真实存在由 GitHub tag 列表确认，
    不是猜的，所以不会点进 404）
  - 该版本没打 tag，或 GitHub 列表读不到（限流 / 离线）→ 退回仓库的发布列表 `releases`，
    不在页面上放一个点进去是 404 的版本号

![展开历史版本](./screenshots/selection.png)

## 安装

在「插件」页的**发现**标签里搜索 `dsh-plugin-upgrader`，点安装即可。
桌面版请用它自带的插件管理界面安装，命令行改动不了正在运行的桌面 profile。

用 `dsh` 命令行（把 `web` 换成你自己的 profile 名）：

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-plugin-upgrader
```

从源码安装：

```bash
git clone https://github.com/zuwenyin/dsh-plugin-upgrader.git
cd dsh-plugin-upgrader
dsh plugin --profile web add "$PWD"
```

装好后打开「插件」页，顶部会多出「版本」标签。不需要重新构建，也不用重启。

## 工作原理

浏览器端读不到 profile 的依赖清单，也无法可靠直连 npm（CORS、私有源、token），
因此所有包操作都放在宿主端：

| 路由 | 作用 |
| --- | --- |
| `GET /api/plugin-upgrader/overview` | 已安装插件 + 各插件已发布版本（registry packument，5 分钟缓存，10 秒超时） |
| `POST /api/plugin-upgrader/job` | 提交一批升级 / 切换步骤，立即返回 job id |
| `GET /api/plugin-upgrader/job?id=…` | 轮询进度与逐项结果 |
| `POST /api/plugin-upgrader/cancel` | 中断当前步骤 |

所有路由仅限本机回环访问：批量操作会安装软件包，配对设备或跨站页面一律拒绝。

### 为什么「切换版本」是「先卸载再安装」

`pluginManager.installBundle` 对已安装的包名会以 `already-installed` 拒绝，
所以换版本必须是 remove + install（官方「更新」走的也是同一条路）。
旧版本号会回传给界面，用于提示这是降级。

### enabled 状态保留

卸载会丢掉插件原有的启用 / 禁用状态，因此每一步在安装完成后会按操作前的状态
重新 `setBundleEnabled`，禁用中的插件升级后仍然是禁用状态。

### 同一时刻只跑一批

宿主端一次只允许一个 job。重复提交会拿到 `409 busy`（带正在跑的那个 job id），
界面据此**接管**那一批的进度显示，而不是弹一条看不懂的错误：

- 新开一个插件页标签、或在进度跑着时再点「一键升级」，都会看到正在进行的那一批
- `overview` 里带 `active` 字段，标签页一挂载就能接上正在跑的任务
- job 每隔几秒写一次心跳时间戳，宿主重启后遗留的「僵尸 job」会按心跳超时自动作废，
  不会永久占着位置让之后所有升级都撞 `busy`

主进程重启会让正在跑的 job 中断，界面会把这种情况显示为失败而不是永远转圈。

## 项目结构

```
dsh-plugin-upgrader/
├── src/                  源码（TypeScript）
│   ├── index.ts          宿主端入口：路由注册、job 调度
│   ├── host/             宿主端逻辑（Node，无 DOM）
│   │   ├── overview.ts   组装 overview 载荷
│   │   ├── registry.ts   registry packument 拉取 / 裁剪、GitHub tag 列表
│   │   ├── install.ts    单步安装 + enabled 状态恢复
│   │   ├── bundle.ts     插件元数据（来源分类、多语言字段、图标）
│   │   ├── repo.ts       仓库 URL 归一化
│   │   ├── version.ts    semver 比较、发布页链接
│   │   ├── http.ts       回环校验、JSON 读写
│   │   └── manager.ts    宿主 pluginManager 服务的最小类型契约
│   └── client/           浏览器端（拆成模块，由 esbuild 打成一个文件）
│       ├── index.ts      createPlugin(require)：槽位注册入口
│       ├── components/   Tab / PluginRow / VersionLine / JobPanel
│       ├── copy.ts       zh / en 文案
│       ├── styles.ts     作用域 CSS
│       ├── hooks.ts      locale 订阅、overview 拉取
│       ├── api.ts        fetch 封装、job 轮询
│       ├── format.ts     版本号 / 日期 / 外部链接
│       ├── env.ts        window 上的最小类型声明
│       └── types.ts      载荷类型
├── lib/                  构建产物（git 忽略，`pnpm run build` 生成）
│   ├── index.js          宿主端入口（tsc 输出）
│   ├── host/*.js         宿主端模块 + .d.ts
│   └── client.js         浏览器端单文件 bundle（含 __ModuleLoader__ 包装）
├── scripts/build.mjs     构建脚本：tsc 编译宿主端 + esbuild 打包 client（加 --watch 即 dev）
├── test/                 node:test 单元测试（.ts，Node 24 直接剥离类型）
├── locale/               （保留）语言包
├── assets/icon.svg       图标
├── cordis.patch.yml      bundle 注册
└── package.json
```

浏览器端虽然拆成了多个 `.ts` 模块，但最终由 esbuild 打成一个 `lib/client.js`，
外面套上 `window.__ModuleLoader__.load({ id, factory(require) { … } })`。
运行时它只能 `require('react')` 这类由宿主提供的模块，不能 require 自己的其它文件，
所以「拆模块」只发生在源码层，产物仍然是单文件。

## 开发

本项目用 pnpm 管理依赖（`package.json` 里钉了 `packageManager`，CI 也用 pnpm）：

```bash
pnpm install       # 安装依赖（会自动跑 prepare → 构建一次）
pnpm run dev       # 监听 src/，宿主端和浏览器端改完即编译（Ctrl+C 停止）
pnpm run build     # tsc 编译宿主端 + esbuild 打包 client → lib/
pnpm run typecheck # tsc 检查 src 和 test
pnpm test          # node:test 单元测试（.ts 直接运行）
pnpm run check     # 以上全部（typecheck + build + test）
```

宿主端在 `src/index.ts`（`webServer` 前缀路由 `/api/plugin-upgrader`），
浏览器端在 `src/client/index.ts`（注册 `plugins.tab` 槽位）。

`pnpm run dev` 会并行跑两个监听器：`tsc --watch` 负责 `lib/index.js` 和
`lib/host/**`，esbuild 负责 `lib/client.js`，两者输出互不覆盖。注意 esbuild
打包时会直接剥掉类型而不做检查，所以改浏览器端时顺手跑一次 `pnpm run typecheck`。

改完代码后必须重新构建（profile 里的 `link:` 指向本目录，但加载的是 `lib/`，
不是 `src/`）。`pnpm run dev` 已经替你重建了产物，但**插件本身不会热更新**——
要让宿主重新加载本插件，无需重启应用：先 `pluginManager.setBundleEnabled(name, false)`
再 `setBundleEnabled(name, true)`。

## 发布

见 [RELEASING.md](./RELEASING.md)。首次手动发一次，之后打 `v*` tag 由 CI 通过 npm trusted publishing 自动发布：

```bash
pnpm publish --access public   # 仅首次
```

## 许可

[MIT](./LICENSE)

plugins.description: 网页快照：URL / 批量 / sitemap → Markdown（标题、正文、日期、来源），离线可测
plugins.readme_text:
# @deepwhale-cn/dsh-web-snapshot

[![Listed on dsh-plugin.org](https://dsh-plugin.org/badges/listed.svg)](https://dsh-plugin.org/plugins/feely0208/dsh-web-snapshot)

**网页快照**：把 URL 抓成干净 Markdown（标题 / 正文 / 来源 / 抓取时间），一次抓一批，失败不中断。

**关键词**：网页快照 · 网页转 Markdown · URL 转 Markdown · 正文提取 · 批量抓取 · sitemap · 离线素材
**Keywords**: web snapshot · URL to markdown · HTML to markdown · batch crawl · sitemap

## 不装会怎样

把网页内容喂给模型或存成知识库时，直接复制粘贴会带上导航、页脚、广告和一堆脚本；用 `curl` 抓下来又是满屏 HTML。更重要的是：**抓下来的东西没有来源和抓取时间，过两周就说不清是哪一版**。批量抓十个链接，中间一条 404 就整批中断 —— 这个插件把这些琐事收成一条命令。

## 能做什么

- **`url <URL>`**：抓单个页面 → 一个 `.md`，含 `# 标题`、正文、`来源`、`抓取时间`、状态码。
  - 去 `script` / `style` / `nav` / `footer` / `aside` / `form` 等干扰
  - 正文优先取 `<article>` → `<main>` → 常见 content 容器 → `<body>`
  - 保留标题、段落、列表、链接、图片、引用、代码块、简单表格；相对链接 / 图片自动转绝对地址
- **`batch --input <urls.txt>`**：一行一个 URL（`#` 开头为注释），逐条抓取；**单条失败不中断**，最后汇总成功 / 失败数量和对应文件名。
- **`sitemap <sitemap.xml|URL>`**：读取 `urlset` 或 `sitemapindex`（子 sitemap 自动展开，最多 10 个），`--limit` 限制列出条数，`--out` 写出 URL 列表文件。
- **安全默认值**：只允许 `http/https`（拒绝 `file:` / `ftp:` / `data:`）；单次请求超时 **10s**；响应上限 **5MB**；带明确的 User-Agent。
- **`--json`** 给流水线；`--demo` 自起本地 HTTP 服务，把单页 / 批量（含失败）/ sitemap 全套跑通，全程不联网。

## 不能做什么

- ❌ **不执行 JavaScript**：SPA / 需要登录 / 反爬校验的页面，抓到的只是初始 HTML，正文可能是空的。
- ❌ **正文提取是启发式**：按 `article/main` 和常见 class 猜正文，复杂页面可能漏内容或混入推荐位、评论；提取边界不保证。
- ❌ **嵌套列表、复杂表格会被拍平**：MVP 只保证常见结构的可读性，不追求像素级还原。
- ❌ **不下载资源**：图片只保留 Markdown 链接，不落地图片 / PDF / 附件，也不做爬虫调度和代理池。
- ❌ **不做 robots / ToS 判断**：是否允许抓取由使用者自行确认并承担后果；本工具不绕过任何访问控制。
- ⚠️ 纯 Node 内置 `fetch`，不装依赖；不负责渲染、截图、OCR。

## 安装

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add @deepwhale-cn/dsh-web-snapshot
# 或纯 CLI
npx @deepwhale-cn/dsh-web-snapshot --help
```

## 用法

```bash
dsh-web-snapshot url https://example.com/article
dsh-web-snapshot url <URL> --out snapshots/         # 指定输出目录
dsh-web-snapshot url <URL> --out page.md            # 指定文件名
dsh-web-snapshot batch --input urls.txt --out snapshots/
dsh-web-snapshot sitemap https://example.com/sitemap.xml --limit 20
dsh-web-snapshot sitemap --input local-sitemap.xml
dsh-web-snapshot --demo
```

退出码：`0` 全部成功 · `1` 有抓取失败 · `2` 用法错误 / 非法 URL 或协议。
输出目录里已有同名文件时会先备份为 `.bak` 再覆盖。

## License

MIT © 温州深鲸智能科技有限公司

plugins.description: Annotate web pages in the DSH right-Sidebar Browser tab: element/region comments with screenshots, merged into your next message.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-web-annotation · 网页批注

在 DeepSeek Harness 桌面端**右侧边栏的 Browser 标签页**里批注网页：点选元素、点击空白位置或框选区域，写下修改意见；插件会自动保存截图与结构化报告，并把**合并后的批注报告随你的下一条消息一起发送**。

给"做的网页"或任意打开的网站提精确修改意见时，不用再截图、圈画、手打元素描述。

[![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT-blue.svg)](LICENSE)
[![DSH](https://img.shields.io/badge/DSH-0.2.1--rc.2-informational)](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness)
![No build](https://img.shields.io/badge/build-none-success)


## 功能

- **连续批注**：点选元素、点空白位置（「点击位置」批注）、拖动框选区域，保存后可以接着批注下一条。
- **就地编辑**：气泡里输入意见，`Enter` 保存、`Shift+Enter` 换行、`Esc` 取消；已保存的批注点编号可重新编辑，✓ 保存、垃圾桶删除。
- **截图证据**：每条批注自动裁剪元素/区域截图（点击位置会带上下文），保存为 `NN.png`。
- **报告落盘**：每一批生成 `report.md`、`annotations.json` 和截图，存放在 `$DSH_HOME/annotations/<sessionId>/<timestamp>/`，方便模型和人工复查。
- **合并发送**：多次结束批注、多个页面得到的批注会合并成**一份总报告**（按页面分组，报告路径合并列出），不会再重复标题。
- **自动附加**：发送消息时由 Host 把报告并入**你正在发送的那条用户消息**——消息可见、可回放，模型也直接收到；插件不直接改写会话日志。
- **中途发送也完整**：批注模式还没结束就发送时，后台会先把这批批注落成截图/报告，随消息一起发出；消息被消费后自动退出批注模式，同一批批注不会重复附到下一条消息。
- **页面干扰抑制**：批注模式下一层透明捕获层挡住页面自身的悬浮弹层/链接跳转；跨域 iframe 可按整个元素/区域批注（内部元素受浏览器限制无法精确批注）。
- **轻量**：纯 JS，无构建、无运行时依赖，不改官方 Browser/Chat 提供方。

## 与同类插件的区别

DSH 社区已经有多款批注类插件（例如 [cslkkl/dsh-web-annotator](https://github.com/cslkkl/dsh-web-annotator)、[zhxnix/dsh-sidebar-annotations](https://github.com/zhxnix/dsh-sidebar-annotations)、[Shuffle-1992/dsh-browser-kit](https://github.com/Shuffle-1992/dsh-browser-kit)、[alaliqing/dsh-annotate](https://github.com/alaliqing/dsh-annotate)）。本插件刻意保持**窄而轻**：

- 只做"网页批注 + 截图 + 报告 + 随消息发送"，不接管官方 Browser/Chat/Layout 提供方，不附带浏览器自动化、DevTools、WebHID 等能力；
- 差异化在**证据与落盘**：每条批注都有截图和本地报告文件，批注报告作为普通消息文本随对话持久化；
- 代价是能力不如重型套件：没有源码映射/组件链、没有画布内对象标注、没有模型侧浏览器工具。

## 安装

要求：**DSH 桌面端 0.2.1-rc.2**（已在此版本实机验证）。插件需要 Host 半代码，安装/更新后要**重启 DSH**。

### 方式 A：插件管理页（桌面端推荐）

1. 从 [Releases](https://github.com/HXwHSJS/dsh-web-annotation/releases) 下载 `dsh-web-annotation-0.1.1.tgz`；
2. 打开 DSH 的**设置 → 插件**，使用安装入口选择本地 tgz / 填入 tgz 绝对路径安装（Desktop 的 `desktop` profile 由 Electron 管理，CLI 可能拒绝直接 `add` 它）；
3. 完全退出并重新打开 DSH。

### 方式 B：CLI 管理的 Web / Headless profile

```sh
dsh plugin --profile <profile> add \
  https://github.com/HXwHSJS/dsh-web-annotation/releases/download/v0.1.1/dsh-web-annotation-0.1.1.tgz
```

也可以直接从 GitHub 源码安装（无构建脚本，不需要 `allowBuilds`）：

```sh
dsh plugin --profile <profile> add github:HXwHSJS/dsh-web-annotation#<commit-sha>
```

安装后重启对应 profile 的 Host，刷新页面。

### 方式 C：本地开发

```sh
git clone https://github.com/HXwHSJS/dsh-web-annotation.git
dsh plugin --profile <profile> add "link:/absolute/path/to/dsh-web-annotation"
```

## 使用

1. 在会话右侧打开 **Browser** 标签页并访问任意 `http(s)` 页面；
2. 点击侧栏控件条上的**批注图标**（分栏/全屏按钮左侧）进入批注模式；
3. 点元素 / 点空白处 / 拖动框选，在气泡里写意见，`Enter` 保存；继续下一条；
4. 退出批注模式后，输入框上方出现「批注 xN」小块；
5. 正常输入并发送消息——批注报告会并入这条消息。

批注模式未退出就直接发送也可以：后台会保存当前批次并随消息发出，发送后自动退出批注模式。

## 发出的消息长这样

```text
网页批注（共 3 条）

页面：控制台（https://example.com/#dashboard）
页面源文件（推断）：./src/pages/dashboard.html
1. [元素] 「导出」：按钮颜色太浅，和背景对比度不够
2. [区域] 640×240：这块留白太大，压缩一半

页面：控制台（https://example.com/#settings）
3. [元素] 「点击位置」：这里想加一个「重置」入口

完整批注报告：C:\Users\<you>\.dsh\annotations\session-...\report.md；...
批注数据：...；...
截图目录：...；...
```

## 隐私与安全

- **无外网请求、无遥测**。插件的 HTTP 路由由本机 DSH Host 提供，只接收 DSH 页面发来的批注数据。
- 报告和截图只写入 `$DSH_HOME/annotations/<sessionId>/<timestamp>/`（默认 `~/.dsh/annotations`）。
- 批注文字与报告路径会作为用户消息的一部分发给模型，和用户自己输入的文字一样；截图默认留在本地。
- 批注模式会向当前 `<webview>` 注入运行时（`executeJavaScript`）并读取被批注页面的 DOM 信息；只在批注模式启用时运行。
- 安全模型与漏洞报告方式见 [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md)。

## 已知限制

- 仅桌面端（依赖右侧边栏 Browser 的 Electron `<webview>`）；Web 版右侧栏是跨域 iframe，无法注入。
- 批注控件所在的那排侧栏按钮没有官方插件扩展位，靠实测 DOM 插入并持续校正；DSH 升级若改了这一排结构可能需要小修。
- 气泡固定用浅色卡片，暂不跟随宿主深色主题。
- 跨域 iframe 内部、closed Shadow DOM、Canvas 内部对象无法精确批注；iframe/Canvas 只能作为整体元素或区域批注。
- 页面导航/刷新后页面内标记会丢失（已落盘/已发送的报告不受影响）。
- 批注模式中途发送时，后台静默保存会为每次"批注集变化"生成报告目录；旧目录保留不自动清理（只有最新一份被消息引用）。
- 自动附加依赖 Host 的 `agent/pre-step` 与 DSH 会话日志接口，目前以 `0.2.1-rc.2` 为验证基线；更新 DSH 后请做一次"批注 → 发送 → 重启 → 会话能加载"的回归。

## 兼容性

| 项 | 值 |
| --- | --- |
| DSH | 0.2.1-rc.2（验证基线） |
| 平台 | Desktop（Windows 已验证；代码平台无关） |
| 运行时依赖 | 无 |
| 构建 | 无 |

## 开发

```sh
npm run check   # node --check index.js + client.js
npm test        # 离线运行时 harness（26 项）
npm run verify  # 两者
```

代码结构：

| 文件 | 作用 |
| --- | --- |
| `client.js` | Web 半：侧栏控件、输入框上方小块与桥、注入页面的批注运行时、报告合并、pending 同步 |
| `index.js` | Host 半：`/dsh-annotate/*` 路由、报告落盘、pending 批次、`agent/pre-step` 把批注并入用户消息 |
| `cordis.patch.yml` | bundle 插入 profile 的 loader 行 |
| `tests/runtime-harness.cjs` | 从 `client.js` 抽出 `runtimeMain()`，用 DOM 桩驱动 26 项检查 |
| `locale/*.json` | 插件管理页的标题与描述 |

贡献说明见 [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md)，更新记录见 [CHANGELOG.md](CHANGELOG.md)。

## License

[MIT](LICENSE) © 2026 HXwHSJS

本项目是独立社区插件，与 DeepSeek 官方无隶属关系。

---

### English

Annotate pages in the DSH right-Sidebar Browser tab: click elements, blank
positions, or drag regions; write notes in an inline bubble; screenshots and a
Markdown/JSON report are saved under `$DSH_HOME/annotations`. Multiple batches
are merged into one report that is attached to your next sent message (durable
and visible in the chat). No build step, no runtime dependencies, no telemetry.
Requires DSH Desktop `0.2.1-rc.2`; restart DSH after install/update.

plugins.description: DSH (DeepSeek Harness) plugin: CodeMirror Markdown composer with paste-URL-as-link, plus brand-icon link rendering in sent user messages
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-link-plugin

One DSH browser plugin that gives the composer Codex-style link behaviour and
renders Markdown links in sent user messages.

## What it does

1. **Markdown takeover composer** — replaces the native plain-text composer
   with a CodeMirror 6 editor (live Markdown rendering, `Enter` sends,
   `Shift+Enter` breaks the line, a render/source toggle, attachment bar,
   model/permission/command/queue faces). Inherited from
   `dsh-markdown-input`; see `patches/README.md` for the exact fork.
2. **Paste a URL onto selected text** — select `repo`, press `Cmd/Ctrl+V` with
   `https://github.com/...` on the clipboard: the selection becomes
   `[repo](https://github.com/...)` and is **rendered immediately** as the
   underlined `repo` (no raw Markdown shown; source reappears only while the
   caret is inside the link). One `Cmd/Ctrl+Z` reverts it.
3. **Sent-message link rendering** — in the chat history, `[repo](url)` in a
   user message renders as a brand icon (GitHub, npm, ... via the host's
   `LinkIconMedium`) + underlined label, alternating with the host's own
   user-text projection. Model input and copy/clipboard keep the Markdown
   source.
4. **Graceful fallback** — if the takeover card cannot mount (host drift,
   missing services), it reverts to the native composer with the draft intact,
   and the merged-in native-composer paste interceptor still turns
   "selection + URL paste" into a Markdown link.

## Target

DSH Desktop / Web **0.2.1-rc.2** (macOS desktop tested). The upstream base is
the `0.2.0-rc.x` line; this fork is re-verified against 0.2.1-rc.2.

Known limits:

- Upstream's own "user messages as Markdown" seat is disabled on 0.2.1-rc.2
  (the host's `projectUserText` primitive is gone). User bubbles therefore stay
  plain text except for the link rendering this plugin adds.
- Composer links render as an underlined label (no favicon) and are not
  clickable while editing; sent-bubble links open in a new window.
- The base is an alpha upstream; a future `dsh-markdown-input` release that
  supports 0.2.1 natively should be preferred over re-applying these patches.

## Install into a profile

```sh
cp -R <this-dir> ~/.dsh/profiles/desktop/plugins/dsh-link-plugin
# ~/.dsh/profiles/desktop/package.json:
#   "dependencies": { "dsh-link-plugin": "file:./plugins/dsh-link-plugin" }
#   "dsh": { "profile": { "bundles": [ ..., "dsh-link-plugin" ] } }
cd ~/.dsh/profiles/desktop && pnpm install
```

The profile host HMR recomposes live; restart DSH if the row does not appear.
Disable it from the sidebar **Plugins** page to get the native composer back.

## Maintenance

- Rebuild `lib/client.js`: `python3 patches/apply-patches.py /path/to/unpacked/dsh-markdown-input`
- Re-test the merged bundle without a browser: `node patches/smoke.mjs`
  (fake lazy-CJS host; asserts the extras register, the rule matches and the
  renderer output shape).
- License: MIT; upstream attribution in `LICENSE` and `THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md`.

plugins.description: DSH plugin market index (format 1) listing the DeepSeek Harness bundles published by @Silentforfar.
plugins.readme_text:
# DSH plugin market index

A [DSH](https://github.com/deepseek-ai) (DeepSeek Harness) **plugin market index** in [format 1](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness), listing the bundles published by [@Silentforfar](https://github.com/Silentforfar).

**Index URL**

```text
https://silentforfar.github.io/dsh-market-index/index.json
```

DSH ships no official market: a market is exactly this file, hosted anywhere over https. The **Discover** tab of the Plugins page reads the index sources you add.

## Use it

1. Open **Plugins** in the DSH Web sidebar.
2. Select **More** next to **Experimental plugins** and switch on **Custom plugin markets**. The page then shows **Installed** and **Discover**.
3. In **Discover**, add the index URL above.
4. Install any listed bundle. DSH installs it into the current profile, pins the exact commit, and keeps the index source for later updates.

The Host caches a successful read for ten minutes and refuses redirects, so a release shows up after the cache expires or after the index is re-read.

## What is listed

| Plugin | What it does |
|---|---|
| [`@silentforfar/dsh-session-menu`](https://github.com/Silentforfar/dsh-session-menu) | Session menu extras: export log, reveal workspace folder, mark unread, permanent delete. |
| [`@silentforfar/dsh-side-task`](https://github.com/Silentforfar/dsh-side-task) | Opens a temporary session in the right sidebar, in the same workspace with its own context. |
| [`@silentforfar/dsh-qq-screenshot`](https://github.com/Silentforfar/dsh-qq-screenshot) | Captures a screen region with QQ's screenshot tool and hands the image to the model. |
| [`@silentforfar/dsh-computer-use`](https://github.com/Silentforfar/dsh-computer-use) | Windows desktop control: window screenshots, UI Automation trees, and real input actions. |

Every version is a `git` source pinned to a full 40-character commit, so an install is reproducible and independent of any branch moving later. Nothing here is published to npm; installs come straight from the plugin repositories.

## Maintainer notes

`index.json` is the published document. Each entry carries display metadata (title, description, icon, category, labels, keywords) and one or more pinned versions.

```bash
npm install          # the official format-1 validator, the same package DSH reads with
npm run validate     # parse index.json, print every install spec, fail on the first violated rule
npm run pin          # re-pin versions to the HEAD commit of each sibling plugin repo
```

`npm run pin` expects the plugin repositories next to this one:

```text
DSH/
  dsh-market-index/     this repository
  dsh-session-menu/
  dsh-side-task/
  dsh-qq-screenshot/
  dsh-computer-use/
```

Release checklist:

1. In the plugin repository: bump `version` in `package.json`, commit, push.
2. Here: `npm run pin`, which adds a version entry for the new number and refreshes the icons.
3. `npm run validate`, then commit and push `index.json`.

A commit that changes code without a version bump is re-pinned in place, which existing installs do **not** see as an update — bump the version when you want the change delivered.

## Format notes

- `title` and `description` are either a plain string or an object keyed by lowercase language id with `en` required.
- `metadata.category` and every `metadata.labels` id must be declared in `metadata.categories` / `metadata.labels`.
- `icon` must be an https URL or a base64 SVG/PNG/JPEG/WebP data URL of at most 32 KiB decoded.
- `publishTimestamp` is Unix seconds; versions of one plugin are ordered by SemVer precedence, not by timestamp.

## 中文说明

这是一个 **DSH 插件市场索引**（format 1）。DSH 本身不带官方市场：所谓"市场"就是这个 JSON 文件，放在任意 https 地址上，用户在 Plugins → Discover 里把地址加进去即可浏览和安装。

安装步骤：打开侧栏 **Plugins** → **Experimental plugins** 旁的 **More** → 打开 **Custom plugin markets** → 进 **Discover** → 添加

```text
https://silentforfar.github.io/dsh-market-index/index.json
```

之后列表里会出现在上表中列出的四个插件，点安装即可，装进当前 profile。

维护方式：插件仓库发了新版本后，在这个仓库里执行 `npm run pin` 重新钉住提交、再 `npm run validate` 校验、最后提交并推送 `index.json`。每个版本都钉死 40 位 commit，安装结果可复现。

## License

MIT

plugins.description: DeepInfra provider for DeepSeek Harness (dsh): live model catalog, streaming chat completions, tool calls, reasoning, and images.
plugins.readme_text:
# DeepInfra provider for DeepSeek Harness

Use [DeepInfra](https://deepinfra.com) models from [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) (`dsh`).
The plugin registers a `deepinfra` provider route and streams over DeepInfra's OpenAI-compatible chat-completions API.

- **Live model catalog.** Models come from `GET https://api.deepinfra.com/v1/openai/models`, so new DeepInfra models appear without a plugin update. Only chat models are listed.
- **Real model facts.** Each model reports its own context window, image input (`vision`), and reasoning-effort levels. Compaction timing and the model picker use these values, so nothing has to be typed into settings.
- **Tool calls, reasoning, and images.** Parallel tool calls, `reasoning_content` (also sent back on later turns so thinking models can continue a tool loop), and image input on vision models.
- **Prompt caching.** The DSH session id goes out as `prompt_cache_key`, so repeated turns reuse their cached prefix.
- **No conflict with your own routes.** It adds a route beside `llm-pi-ai` and does not modify it.

## Install

Needs Node ≥ 22.15 and a DeepInfra API token (https://deepinfra.com/dash/api_keys).

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add github:deepinfra/dsh-provider-deepinfra
export DEEPINFRA_API_KEY=...   # or store it from the web Models page
dsh web
```

Pick a DeepInfra model in the model picker, or make one the default:

```yaml
# $DSH_HOME/profiles/<profile>/cordis.patch.yml
- id: agent-default-model
  config:
    provider: deepinfra
    model: deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4-Flash
```

## Configuration

| Field | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `baseURL` | `https://api.deepinfra.com/v1/openai` | OpenAI-compatible API root |
| `apiKeyEnv` | `DEEPINFRA_API_KEY` | Credential reference resolved for each request through the DSH credential service, or from the environment when the composition has none |

```yaml
- id: provider-deepinfra
  config:
    apiKeyEnv: MY_DEEPINFRA_TOKEN
```

## Behavior

- The catalog is cached for 10 minutes. If the listing is unreachable, the last good listing is served, or a small built-in list if there was never one, so the route never comes up empty. A model id missing from the listing (for example, a private deployment) can still be requested; its context window is reported as unknown rather than guessed.
- Without an API key the picker lists no DeepInfra models, because every request would fail.
- Reasoning: models DeepInfra tags `reasoning_effort` offer `Off`, `Low`, `Medium`, `High`; models tagged only `reasoning` offer `Off`/`On` (`none`/`high` on the wire). The choice goes out as `reasoning_effort`, and leaving it unset keeps the model's own default. Some models, such as DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash, do not think unless you turn it on.
- HTTP failures map to DSH failure codes: `401` → `INVALID_CREDENTIAL`, `402` or quota text → `QUOTA`, `429` → `RATE_LIMIT` (with `Retry-After`), context-overflow `400` → `CONTEXT_WINDOW_EXCEEDED`, `5xx` → `SERVER`. `dsh-llm-retry` retries the transient ones.
- Images go inline as base64 data URLs, scaled to ~4 MP and 1 MiB each. When one request's images exceed 20 MiB, DSH is asked to offload the oldest ones.

## Development

```sh
npm install
npm test
```

The tests include a contract check: every `GenerateOptions` field declared by the installed `@deepseek-ai/dsh-llm` must have an entry in `REQUEST_FIELD_DISPOSITION` (`lib/request.js`). When DSH adds a request field, the test fails until the field is handled or deliberately ignored.

## License

MIT

plugins.description: Control DeepSeek Harness from AirPods head gestures (via HeadOrbit): nod = allow / confirm, shake = reject / next option — with a one-click installer for the menu-bar app.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-airpod-control 用 **AirPods 的头部动作**回答 DeepSeek Harness 里的两件事，同一套手势： | 场景 | 点头 | 摇头 | | --- | --- | --- | | **权限许可**（approval） | 允许（`allowed-once`） | 拒绝 | | **模型提问**（`ask_user_question`，3 个以上选项） | 确认当前项 | 切到下一项 |

手势由 [HeadOrbit](https://github.com/Cogria-AI/HeadOrbit)（AirPods 头部追踪的 macOS 菜单栏 App）识别， 经本机回环 HTTP 送到这个插件。插件在这里做了四件事： - **自动装好 HeadOrbit**：插件自带安装器，页面右下角一张卡片就能下载、安装、写配置、启动、等心跳； 装到 `~/Applications/HeadOrbit.app`，端口和 token 全自动，用户不用手填。 - **当审批回答者**：只有真有请求在等、且 HeadOrbit 在线时才认领，否则一行都不碰。 - **当提问回答者**：点头/摇头答题；3 个以上选项时摇头切换、点头确认。 - **手势答完撤掉网页卡片**：插件带一个浏览器半区，把已经被手势结算的那张卡片收掉， 不会出现「点头同意了、卡片还挂在页面上」。 ## 安装 ```bash dsh plugin --profile desktop add dsh-airpod-control ``` > `--profile` 换成你实际在用的那个（桌面版默认 `desktop`，`dsh web` 是 `web`）。 > npm 包：，当前版本 `0.3.0`。 想改代码就从源码装： ```bash git clone https://github.com/fishcg/dsh-airpod-control.git ~/dsh-airpod-control dsh plugin --profile desktop add link:~/dsh-airpod-control ``` 装完重启 DSH，打开任意会话，右下角会出现「用点头 / 摇头回答 DSH」的卡片，点一下即可： 1. 下载 HeadOrbit（MIT，源码在 [fishcg/HeadOrbit-dsh](https://github.com/fishcg/HeadOrbit-dsh)）并装到 `~/Applications` 2. 把 DSH 的端口和共享 token 写进它的偏好，启动它 3. 等它开始轮询（说明链路通了） 4. 引导去「系统设置 → 隐私与安全性 → 动作与健身」给 HeadOrbit 打勾（**只能由系统弹窗授予**，所以这一步需要你点一下） 不想点卡片也可以一条命令： ```bash curl -s -X POST "http://127.0.0.1:/dsh-airpod-control/setup/run" | jq ``` 共享 token 也不需要手填：配置里留空时会自动生成一份，落在 `~/.dsh-airpod-control/token` （0600），安装器会把同一个值写进 HeadOrbit。 > 首次使用前请戴好 AirPods（Pro / 3 / 4 / Beats 等支持头部追踪的型号），并在 HeadOrbit 设置里确认「已连接」。 ## 怎么用 1. 戴好耳机，HeadOrbit 菜单栏图标显示已连接。 2. 会话里出现审批卡片 / 提问卡片：`点头` 会按下的那个按钮（审批里的「允许」）会被**描边点亮**， 一眼看得出点头会选什么。 3. **点头** = 允许（审批）或确认当前选项（提问）；**摇头** = 拒绝或切到下一个选项。 4. 手势一落定，卡片就收起（宿主结算后就收回），所以插件会补一句结果： `已允许 <工具>` / `已拒绝 <工具>` / `已选择 <选项>`。这句话优先说在**小鲸鱼头顶的气泡**里 （装了 [`dsh-whale-widget`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-whale-widget) 时）， 没装鲸鱼就退化成屏幕顶部的提示条——不然卡片消失得太快，人会不知道自己刚才选了什么。 手势和网页按钮**同时有效**，谁先到算谁的：插件认领请求时也调用 `next()`，卡片照常渲染， 你在页面上点「允许」和做一个手势是在赛跑。没有回答者时 DSH 本来就是 fail closed，本插件不改变这个性质。 ### 顺手：按住 ← 或 → 说话 官方的语音输入插件（`dsh-experimental-voice-input-bundle`）没有快捷键，只能点输入框旁边那个麦克风。 本插件的浏览器半区补了一个：**同时按住 ← 和 → 开始录音，松开任意一个就结束并转录**，文字照常落进输入框草稿。 - 没装官方语音插件时完全不生效，`⌃Space` 该干什么还是什么（只找得到按钮时才会拦截按键）。 - 单个方向键完全不拦截（光标照常移动）；只有左右两个方向键**同时按住**时才录音。 - 带 ⌘/⌃/⌥/⇧ 的组合一律放行。 - 也保留 ⌃Space（按下即开始、松开即停止）作为备用。 - 它会真的"点一下"那个麦克风按钮，所以屏幕上的录音状态、波形、取消按钮都是官方组件自己的， 失败提示（没权限、没模型、转录失败）也照常显示。 ### 设置页 **设置 → 左侧栏「AirPods 控制」**（右侧栏里和皮肤插件那几个并列）里能改手感，点保存即时生效，不用重启 DSH： | 项 | 作用 | | --- | --- | | 点头 / 摇头幅度 | 转多少度算一次手势；旁边两条进度条是**实时幅度**，边说边调最直观 | | 语音输入按键 | 按住 ← + →、⌃Space、或关掉 | | 高亮当前选项 | 摇头切选项时在卡片上圈出当前项 | | 界面语言 | 跟随系统 / 中文 / English | | 连续手势去重、只在 HeadOrbit 在线时接管 | 高级项，一般不用动 | 界面语言默认问系统要，而不是看浏览器的 `navigator.language`——Electron 里那个值经常是 `en-US`（这台中文 Mac 就是），照它判断会让中文用户看到英文菜单。 ## 演示：点头 = 允许 下面是一段 5 秒的真机录屏——审批卡片弹出后点一次头，卡片自动收起、命令随即执行（摇头就是「拒绝」）： ![点头批准演示](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/fishcg/dsh-airpod-control/master/docs/demo.gif) [下载 mp4 原片](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/fishcg/dsh-airpod-control/master/docs/demo.mp4) ## 截图 首次打开时右下角会自动出现安装卡片（左）；装好后审批卡片长这样（右）： | 一键安装引导 | 审批卡片 | | --- | --- | | | | ## 配置 在 profile 的 `cordis.patch.yml` 里覆盖（都有安全默认值）： | 键 | 默认 | 说明 | | --- | --- | --- | | `enabled` | `true` | 关掉就什么都不注册，等于没装。默认开是因为「HeadOrbit 不在线就不碰请求」，而默认关着太脆：插件管理层重写 profile 层时会把用户手写的行抹掉，插件就静默失效了 | | `token` | `''` | 共享密钥。留空则自动生成到 `~/.dsh-airpod-control/token`（0600）；非空时以配置为准。请求需带 `X-HeadOrbit-Token` | | `nodAllows` | `true` | `false` 则反过来：摇头＝允许、点头＝拒绝 | | `claimQuestions` | `'auto'` | `'off'` 则完全不接模型的提问，只回答权限许可 | | `timeoutMs` | `600000` | 审批没人理时的兜底（按拒绝结算） | | `questionTimeoutMs` | `600000` | 提问没人理时的兜底（工具返回 pending，不是跳过） | | `requireHeadOrbit` | `true` | `false` 时不看心跳、永远抢答（只建议自测时用） | | `aliveWindowMs` | `6000` | HeadOrbit 多久没轮询就当它不在线 | | `debounceMs` | `200` | 两次手势之间的最小间隔 | ## 端点 全部挂在 `/dsh-airpod-control` 前缀下，复用宿主已有的 webServer 路由（因此只听 127.0.0.1）。 除 Host / 同站检查之外，都需要 `X-HeadOrbit-Token`；标了**免 token** 的那几个是给浏览器半区用的， 只读且不含会话内容。 | 方法 | 路径 | 用途 | | --- | --- | --- | | `GET` | `/state` | `{ waiting, kind, label, question?, deadlineAt, canAnswer, headOrbit, ... }`，HeadOrbit 靠它决定要不要发手势，同时它本身就是心跳 | | `GET` | `/health` | 自检：`{ ok, hasToken, hasApprovalAnswerer, hasQuestionAnswerer, headOrbitAlive, answered, ignored }`（不回报 token 本身） | | `GET` | `/events` | 最近的事件流水，排查用 | | `GET` | `/last-decision` | **免 token**：最近一次手势/按键结算了哪个请求（浏览器半区据此撤卡片） | | `GET` | `/cursor` | **免 token**：当前光标落在第几项（只回序号与那一项的文字） | | `GET` | `/setup` | **免 token**：`{ app: { installed, running }, bridge, alive, tokenConfigured, last, running }` | | `POST` | `/setup/run` | **免 token**：下载 + 安装 + 写配置 + 启动 + 等心跳；`{ reinstall?: true }`，返回逐步状态 `steps[]` | | `POST` | `/setup/motion` | **免 token**：打开系统设置的「动作与健身」隐私页 | | `POST` | `/gesture` | `{ "gesture": "nod" \| "shake", "ttlMs": 2000, "requestId"?: "q1" }` | | `POST` | `/answer` | `{ "decision": "allow" \| "reject" \| "select:N", "requestId"?: "q1" }`，没有耳机时的等价入口 | `/state` 里 `kind` 是 `"approval"` 或 `"question"`；等提问时 `question` 会带上题目与选项 （`{ requestId, label, count, questions, deadlineAt, cursor }`）。浏览器半区拿 `question.cursor` 在网页卡片上把「现在点头会选中哪一项」圈出来。带 `requestId` 的调用是网页卡片回的答案， id 对不上会得到 `409 { stale: true }`。 ```console $ curl -s -H "X-HeadOrbit-Token: $TOKEN" http://127.0.0.1:$DSH_WEB_PORT/dsh-airpod-control/health {"ok":true,"plugin":"dsh-airpod-control","version":"0.3.0","hasToken":true,"hasApprovalAnswerer":true,"hasQuestionAnswerer":true,"headOrbitAlive":true,"headOrbitWindowMs":6000,"waiting":false,"waitingKind":null,"answered":3,"ignored":0} ``` 端口就是 DSH 自己的 GUI 端口（`dsh web` 启动时打印的那个）；插件不开新端口。 ## 安全性（值得说清楚） - 不自己开端口：复用宿主已有的 webServer 路由，因此天然只听 127.0.0.1。 - 必须有共享密钥：token 为空时自动生成一份（0600），并要求请求带 `X-HeadOrbit-Token`， 所以本机别的进程即使能访问这个端口也伪造不了答案。 - `/setup*` 是免 token 的（浏览器拿不到 token），因此只接受**回环 Host + 同站请求**； 它做的都是固定参数的本机动作（`defaults` / `ditto` / `open`），请求内容不会进 shell。 装上之后任何本机进程仍然可以调它重装 —— 这在能读你用户目录的进程面前不算新增权限。 - 只回答「正在等待中的那一次请求」：过期的、没有请求在等的、手势与映射不符的，一律忽略； 一次请求只会被结算一次。 - 没有回答者时 DSH 本来就会 fail closed，本插件不改变这一点。 ## 测试 ```bash cd dsh-airpod-control node --test test/plugin.test.js # 52 个用例，手写假宿主，不需要真 DSH ``` 覆盖：审批允许/拒绝/超时/取消、提问（两选项与多选项光标）、请求竞态、token 与 Host/同站校验、 自动生成 token、`/setup` 状态、卡片撤除的依据（`/last-decision`）、手势去抖、`/motion` 实时幅度、 `/settings` 读写与夹取范围、网页半区在 zh/en 下都能加载且两份文案键一致。 ## 排障 **插件像没装**（网页上没卡片、App 日志里 `无法连接服务器`）：先看它在不在。 ```console $ curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}\n' "http://127.0.0.1:$DSH_WEB_PORT/dsh-airpod-control/setup" 200 # 挂载了 404 # 没挂载：看 profile 的 cordis.patch.yml 里 dsh-airpod-control 那行是不是被关掉/抹掉了 ``` **按钮没高亮 / 结果气泡没出现**：先问浏览器那一半活着没有。 ```console $ curl -s "http://127.0.0.1:$DSH_WEB_PORT/dsh-airpod-control/client-state" {"version":"0.3.0","at":1792575600000,"bootAt":1792575590000,"boots":1,"notes":2,"lang":"zh","kind":"note","text":"已允许 Bash","channel":"whale"} ``` `boots: 0` 说明前端那一半根本没加载（改过前端代码要 ⌘R，改过宿主代码要重启）； `notes` 和 `text`/`channel` 是它最近一次说话的内容和走的通道（`whale` = 小鲸鱼气泡，`toast` = 顶部提示条）， 这样能分清「没触发」和「触发了但被鲸鱼的渲染盖掉」。 **端口变了**：`~/.dsh-airpod-control/endpoint.json` 里的 `port` 必须等于当前 GUI 端口。 插件启动后 10 分钟内会一直重试发布，之后任何一次请求也会顺手刷新；App 每轮轮询都会重读这个文件， 所以 DSH 换端口不需要改 App 配置。 **日志**：App 侧 `~/Library/Logs/HeadOrbit-DSHBridge.log`；宿主启动崩溃 `~/Library/Logs/DeepSeek Harness/crash-*-web-boot.log`（`1 entry did not activate` 说明某个插件 半区在 import 阶段抛了异常，整个条目会被停用）。 ## 已知边界 - 只支持 macOS（HeadOrbit 是 macOS 菜单栏 App，用 CoreMotion 读 AirPods）。 - 需要支持头部追踪的耳机；没有耳机时插件不会认领任何请求，行为与未安装一致。 - 手势识别由 HeadOrbit 负责，阈值可在 App 里按自己的幅度校准（点头约 12°、摇头约 19°）。 - 插件和网页卡片是竞态关系：两边同时给答案时，先到的那个生效。 - 安装器下载的是 `fishcg/HeadOrbit-dsh` 的 latest release（ad-hoc 签名、未公证）， 安装后会自动去掉 quarantine 属性；签名/公证版本后续再补。

plugins.readme_text:
# Ark Play — Deepseek Harness ArkStronghold对局插件

提供4个对局工具，允许Agent连接到网页卫服务器。

## 安装发布包

对模型说：`用 ark_start 开一局深渊（终极），按局面与公开说明决策，玩到自然结束。`

工具：ark_start、ark_view、ark_act、ark_lookup、ark_finish。每个执行Agent有独立客户端，卸载时清理工具/连接/Worker。无需插件另带模型密钥，使用DSH现有模型配置。



## 源码开发

源码构建依赖固定到核心提交 `d2e51eacb946e831a6f928a33967151f51dac603` 的 HTTPS 归档，lockfile 记录完整性摘要。可独立克隆本仓库构建：

```sh
git clone https://github.com/HarcoChen/dsh-ArkStronghold.git
cd dsh-ArkStronghold
npm ci --ignore-scripts
npm run build
npm run check:package
npm run pack:release
npm run package -- results/releases
```

## License

GPL-3.0-or-later，见LICENSE；分发附依赖许可与对应源码，不含上游引擎、美术、模型、凭据或对局记录。

# A股分析器（a-share-screener）

> DeepSeek Harness 插件：输入股票名，输出全维度体检报告（市值分档 / 公告风险 / 技术面 / 资金流 / 筹码 / 买卖建议）。
>
> 数据来源：腾讯自选股 CLI + 东方财富公开接口。**不构成投资建议。**

## 功能

| 工具 | 用途 |
| --- | --- |
| **`a_share_analyze`** | **个股深度体检**：输入名称/代码，输出市值分档、PE/PB、公告风险扫描、技术面、资金流、筹码、买卖建议 |
| `a_share_screen` | 批量选股：按 5 日均线战法从股票池筛选候选 |

## 它能识别什么

| 能力 | 说明 |
| --- | --- |
| **准确市值分档** | 超大盘/大盘/中盘/小盘/微盘，参数按档位自适应 |
| **公告风险扫描** | 立案调查、退市风险、计提减值、问询函等，**已过滤例行披露** |
| **ST / 科创 / 北交剔除** | 名称前缀 + 代码规则双判定 |
| **监管介入识别** | 停牌核查、严重异常波动、立案调查 |
| **一字板检测** | 连板数、开板日、累计涨幅 |
| **MACD 深度** | 金叉/死叉时间、柱体趋势、顶底背离、零轴位置 |
| **真假阳线** | 量能确认 + 收盘位置判定 |
| **诱多形态** | 长上影、放量滞涨、冲高回落 |
| **龙虎榜** | 机构 vs 游资、知名席位标签、净买卖 |
| **筹码分布** | 历史迁移、套牢盘、集中度收敛趋势 |

## 快速开始

### 1. 安装到 DeepSeek Harness

```bash
# 克隆到插件目录
git clone https://github.com/maxcloser/a-share-screener.git
```

然后在 DSH 中安装：

```
plugin_manager install_bundle <克隆路径>
```

### 2. 使用

```
a_share_analyze("慈文传媒")
a_share_analyze("sz002343")
```

## 输出示例

```
# 慈文传媒（sz002343）分析报告

## ⛔ 结论：回避（存在财务/合规警示）

### MACD 分析
| 状态 | 金叉（金叉后第 8 日，2026-10-12） |
| 柱体趋势 | 红柱放大（多头增强） |
| 零轴位置 | 零轴上方（强势） |

### 龙虎榜明细
机构专用席位 4 个，净卖出 5135 万
游资席位：拉萨天团、玉兰路

### 详细筹码分布
| 获利盘 / 套牢盘 | 74.8% / 25.2% |
| 平均成本 | 10.27 |
| 90% 集中度 | 29.18 |

### 极端形态与监管
| 连续一字板 | 11 个 |
| 累计涨幅 | +200.19% |
```

## 已知限制

| 限制 | 说明 |
| --- | --- |
| **样本覆盖** | 批量选股用 27 个行业 ETF 前 20 大持仓（约 460 只大中盘），非全市场 |
| **技术面 alpha 很薄** | 实测买点状态超额仅 +0.02%，**定位是风险体检工具，不是盈利预测** |
| **公告依赖关键词** | 已尽力过滤例行披露，仍可能有边界误判 |
| **盘中数据不完整** | 分析结果以收盘数据为准 |

## 免责声明

本项目仅提供**公开数据的规则化统计与整理**，不构成任何投资建议。

- 所有结论来自技术指标与公告文本的机械规则，**不理解基本面**
- 历史形态不预示未来走势
- 数据源可能存在延迟或错误
- **投资决策请自行判断，盈亏自负**

---

# 第一部分：个股深度分析（a_share_analyze）

## 用法

```
a_share_analyze("慈文传媒")
a_share_analyze("sz002343")
a_share_analyze("600519")
```

## 数据来源（两路合并）

| 数据 | 来源 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| K线、技术指标、资金流、筹码、股东 | westock CLI | 原有数据源 |
| **准确市值、PE、PB** | **东财 push2 接口** | 单股查询，实测 100% 可用 |
| **公告全文列表** | **东财 np-anotice 接口** | 用于财务/合规风险扫描 |
| **ST 判定** | 东财返回的股票名称 | 见下方说明 |

> ⚠️ 东财的 `clist` 批量列表接口会触发限流（`fetch failed / other side closed`），
> 因此**不用它拉全市场 ST 名单**，改为基于单股行情返回的名称判定 ST 状态——个股场景下更稳定。

## 剔除规则（命中即判「回避」）

| 规则 | 判定方式 |
| --- | --- |
| 北交所 | 代码 `bj` 开头 → 直接拒绝分析 |
| 科创板 | `sh688xxx` / `sh689xxx` → 直接拒绝分析 |
| ST / 退市风险 | 名称前缀 `ST` / `*ST` / `SST` / `S*ST`，或含「退」 |
| 停牌 | `suspension hs` 名单命中 |

**ST 判定的防误杀**：若 ST 后紧跟英文字母（如 `STAR公司`、`BEST股份`），视为英文单词而非 ST 标记。

## 公告风险扫描

扫描最近 100 条公告，按三级关键词分类：

| 级别 | 关键词示例 | 触发后果 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 🔴 致命 | 立案调查、行政处罚、退市风险警示、无法表示意见、财务造假、违规担保 | 结论直接「回避」 |
| 🟠 严重 | 风险警示、退市、问询函、监管函、计提减值、预亏、首亏 | 结论「回避」（若有 3 条以上） |
| 🟡 提示 | 异常波动、诉讼、质押、资产处置、停牌 | 仅提示，不影响结论 |

### 关键设计：例行披露白名单

A 股大量公告标题是**模板化例行披露**，措辞与风险词重叠。实测发现若不排除会造成严重误报：

| 股票 | 误报的公告标题 | 实际情况 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 贵州茅台 | 「非经营性资金占用及其他关联资金往来情况的专项审计说明」 | **例行披露，非风险** |
| 中天科技 | 同上（会计师事务所专项说明） | **例行披露** |
| 大金重工 | 「非经营性资金占用及其他关联资金往来的专项说明-信会师报字」 | **例行披露** |

因此加入 `ROUTINE_PATTERNS` 白名单，排除：
专项审计说明、内部控制评价、募集资金专项报告、ESG 报告、董事会/监事会/股东大会决议、
独立董事意见、续聘会计师事务所、利润分配、定期报告、审计报告编号等。

**修复效果**（实测）：

| 股票 | 修复前 | 修复后 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 贵州茅台 | 🔴 重大风险（误报） | ✅ 未发现风险 |
| 百亚股份 | 🔴 重大风险（误报） | ✅ 未发现风险 |
| 大金重工 | 🔴 重大风险（误报） | 🟡 需关注 |
| 慈文传媒 | 🔴 重大风险 | 🟠 高度警惕（3 条减值公告，真实） |
| *ST九鼎 | 🔴 重大风险 | 🔴 重大风险（真实退市警示） |

## 市值分档与参数自适应

| 档位 | 流通市值 | 量比要求 | 止损 | 单票仓位上限 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 超大盘 | ≥1000 亿 | 1.5 | -5% | 30% |
| 大盘 | 500-1000 亿 | 1.5 | -5% | 25% |
| 中盘 | 100-500 亿 | 1.8 | -5% | 20% |
| **小盘** | 30-100 亿 | **2.0** | **-6%** | **10%** |
| **微盘** | <30 亿 | **2.5** | **-8%** | **5%** |

依据：小盘股假突破率显著更高，需更严格的量能确认与更小的仓位。

## 结论分级与联动规则

| 结论 | 触发条件 |
| --- | --- |
| ⛔ 回避 | 被剔除 / 财务致命风险 / 严重风险 |
| 🔴 清仓 | 战法判定 exit |
| 🟢 买入 | 战法买点 **且** 未超买（RSI6<90）**且** 偏离MA5<10% |
| 🟡 不建议追高 | 技术面买点，但 RSI6≥90 或偏离MA5≥10% |
| 🔵 持有 | 站稳 5 日线 |
| 🟡 观察 | 条件不满足 |

> **关键修复**：早期版本会出现「既提示高度警惕、又建议买入」的自相矛盾，
> 现已在结论生成阶段加入风险联动——财务风险与超买信号可以否决技术面买点。

---

# 第二部分：批量选股（a_share_screen）

按「5 日均线战法」口诀扫描 A 股，叠加技术面、主力资金、量价、板块共振、大盘环境、筹码与机构持仓，并给出板块分散的组合建议。

## 一、战法规则（用户口诀 + 量能确认）

| 口诀 | 规则 | 实现 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | 没 5% 以上大阳线不参与 | 近 `bigCandleLookback`(20) 日内找 `bigCandlePct`(5%) 以上阳线 |
| **1+** | **大阳线必须放量** | **成交额 ≥ 前 5 日均量 × `bigCandleVolumeRatio`(1.5)，否则判「假阳线，不参与」** |
| 2 | 大阳线后回落碰 5 日线没跌破就买入 | 最低价触及 MA5（容差 `touchTolerancePct` 1%）且收盘 ≥ MA5 → `buy` |
| **2+** | **回踩必须缩量** | **回踩日成交额 ≤ 前 5 日均量 × `pullbackVolumeRatio`(0.8)；放量下跌判「疑似出货」不给买点** |
| 3 | 股价远离 5 日线时减半仓 | 偏离 MA5 ≥ `farAboveMa5Pct`(8%) → 输出减仓动作 |
| 4 | 收盘跌破 5 日线减半仓 | 跌破当日提示减半仓；次日站回提示「仓位补回」（**不再直接清仓**） |
| 5 | 跌破后三天站不回清仓 | 连续 `exitGraceDays`(3) 日跌破 **且 MA5<MA20** 才清仓；否则仅减半仓 |

> 口诀1/2 的量能确认是**硬门槛**：不满足即否决对应口诀。

## 二、离场规则（基于回测算重构）

> 回测（**行业均衡样本** 463 只 / 28 行业，同等 20 日上限）：
>
> | 方案 | 均值 | 中位 | p5（最差5%） | 标准差 |
> | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
> | 固定持有 20 日 | +1.03% | -1.50% | **-18.01%** | 15.12% |
> | **新离场（-5%/+10日）** | **+1.30%** | -2.35% | **-8.06%** | 12.55% |
> | 旧离场（破 MA5） | -0.09% | -1.06% | -4.78% | 5.38% |
>
> 结论：旧「破 MA5 离场」收益为负，应废弃；新规则在**提高均值的同时把尾部风险从 -18% 收敛到 -8%**。
> 代价是胜率偏低（约 25%）——这是「截断亏损、放走盈利」的必然形态，靠少数大赢家覆盖多数小亏。

| 规则 | 触发条件 | 结果 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| **硬止损** | 自大阳线收盘价回撤 ≥ `hardStopPct`(5%) | 清仓 |
| **时间止损** | 大阳线后超过 `holdingDays`(10) 个交易日仍未盈利 | 离场 |
| 口诀4/5 | 跌破 MA5 → 减仓提示；连续3日且 MA5<MA20 → 清仓 | 减仓/清仓 |

## 三、大盘环境（默认不做过滤）

> ⚠️ **重要修正**：早期结论「大盘空头时买点超额 -1.66%，应硬屏蔽」来自**有偏样本**（127 只、54% 是电力设备/电子/医药/军工），已作废。
>
> 在**行业均衡样本**（463 只 / 28 行业）上重测：大盘 MA20 下方时的买点信号平均 **+2.07%**，反而高于多头期的 -0.28%；开启屏蔽会让超额从 **+0.45% 掉到 -0.87%**。

因此默认 **不做大盘过滤**，大盘状态只作为信息展示：

- `requireMarketUp: false`（默认）→ 只展示大盘状态，不否决任何信号
- `requireMarketUp: true` → 大盘走弱时否决，可用 `blockBuyInBearMarket` 选择「降级观察」或「直接屏蔽」

## 四、状态含义

| 状态 | 含义 |
| --- | --- |
| `buy` 买点 | 放量大阳线后**缩量**回踩 5 日线不破，且大盘环境允许 |
| `hold` 持有 | 站稳 5 日线，回踩可加 |
| `bigcandle` 大阳线待回踩 | 今日刚出**放量**大阳线，等回踩，不追高 |
| `watch` 观察 | 回落中、放量回踩、或大盘/可交易性否决 |
| `exit` 清仓 | 硬止损/时间止损触发，或连续破位且 MA5<MA20 |
| `neutral` 不参与 | 无有效大阳线、或买点被大盘硬开关屏蔽 |

## 五、评分权重（多因子，基于回测重做）

| 因子 | 权重 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| MA5 战法 | 30 | 原为 45，过高会把单一图形信号放大 |
| 量价 | 15 | 放量与突破 |
| 资金 | 12 | 原为 20，主力净流入在 A 股偏滞后 |
| 技术 | 10 | MACD/KDJ/RSI |
| 基本面 | 10 | 原为 4，中期收益主要由基本面驱动 |
| 估值/筹码 | 10 | 获利盘比例、平均成本偏离、集中度 |
| 板块 | 8 | 涨幅排名前 `sectorTopN` 才加分 |
| 机构 | 5 | 十大股东机构家数与增减持 |

> 缺失数据的因子不参与加权（不会用 50 分中位数稀释信号）。

## 六、股票池与过滤

**默认排除：科创板（sh688/sh689）、北交所（bj）、ST / 退市风险股、ETF/基金。**
可配置 `excludeBoards: ['kcb','bj','gem']` 额外排除创业板。

**样本池来源（P1-③，行业均衡设计）：**
1. **行业均衡 ETF 持仓池** —— **一行业一只 ETF**，覆盖申万一级中 ETF 可投的 **27 个行业**，
   去重后约 **463 只**、覆盖 **28 个行业**，最大单行业占比约 **6.5%**
2. 热点板块领涨股 + 热搜榜
3. 关键词搜索

> **为什么是「一行业一只」而不是叠宽基？**
> 数据源的 `etf-holdings` 每只 ETF 只返回前 20 大持仓。若叠加多只宽基，前 20 权重股高度重叠，
> 会重复放大大盘股；若混入行业主题 ETF（如军工/煤炭/医药），则会让少数行业占样本一半以上。
> 实测对比：
>
> | 方案 | 样本数 | 行业数 | 最大单行业占比 | 前3行业合计 |
> | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
> | 早期（10 只宽基+主题混合） | 127 | 22 | 15.7%（电力设备） | **44.1%** |
> | **当前（27 只行业 ETF）** | **463** | **28** | **6.5%** | **16.4%** |

> 无法覆盖的 4 个行业：轻工制造、商贸零售、美容护理、综合（A 股暂无对应 ETF）。

过滤对所有来源**统一生效**，末尾有兜底校验，并在「处理说明」列出被排除的代码与原因。

ST 判定按 A 股命名规范做前缀匹配（`ST` / `*ST` / `SST` / `S*ST`，且 ST 后不紧跟英文字母），避免把 `STAR公司`、`BEST股份` 误杀；名称含「退」也排除。

- 传入 `codes` 时**同样遵守排除规则**；需强制诊断科创/北交/ST 持仓时显式传 `includeExcluded: true`。

## 七、P2 深度因子与组合构建

- **估值/筹码**（`includeChip`）：获利盘比例 <20% 视为低位加分，>85% 扣分；现价低于平均成本 8% 以上加分，高于 15% 扣分。
- **机构持仓**（`includeShareholder`）：十大股东中机构增持加分、减持扣分。
- 两者**只对入围候选**（粗筛前 N×2）调用，避免全池调用导致耗时爆炸。

**组合构建（P2-⑧）** 输出「组合建议」表：

- 同板块最多 `maxPerSector`(2) 只，控制相关性
- 组合最多 `maxHoldings`(5) 只
- 按评分做轻微倾斜给出建议仓位，单票上限 `maxSinglePositionPct`(30%)

## 八、数据源

腾讯自选股 CLI：`npx -y westock-data-clawhub@1.0.4`。
用到 `search` / `kline` / `technical` / `asfund` / `profile` / `suspension` / `hot` / `board` / `dividend` / `reserve` / `chip` / `shareholder` / `etf-holdings`。

注意事项：
- `quote` 在部分渠道不可用，行情统一走 `kline`。
- 单只查询时 CLI 不返回代码列，解析时用请求代码兜底。
- **盘中数据是未完成的当日K线**，收盘前结论会变；量比会被低估。
- 数据源偶发返回空批次（约 50 字节），看到「全部数据不足」重试一次即可。

## 九、配置

本插件不导出 Cordis `Config`（避免依赖 dsh 内部包），配置写在 `cordis.patch.yml` 的 `config` 里，由 `apply` 宽松归一化：

```yaml
- insert:
    - id: a-share-screener
      name: '@local/a-share-screener'
      config:
        cli:
          package: 'westock-data-clawhub@1.0.4'
          timeoutMs: 60000
        excludeBoards: ['kcb', 'bj']
        excludeST: true
        useEtfPool: true

plugins.description: 按模型自定义上下文窗口的 DSH 插件
plugins.readme_text:
# `dsh-context-presets`

**为 DeepSeek Harness 的每个模型单独设定上下文窗口。**

DSH 用模型的上下文窗口做预算与溢出判断。本插件把这件事收敛成一个入口：右键输入框下方的窗口芯片换档，或在设置弹窗里逐个模型精调。所有取值写入 `llm-pi-ai` 命名空间，由宿主校验与持久化，改动即时生效、无需重启。

> 只调整 DSH 侧的预算基准，**不扩大服务商的真实上限**。自定义值不会超过上游声明的窗口。

## 为什么

同一模型经由不同渠道挂载时真实窗口常常不同，而安装目录给的是保守值；也有人想反向调小窗口，让 DSH 更早压缩。插件把「按模型改窗口」做成一个不依赖第三方插件的小面板。

## 功能

| 能力 | 说明 |
| --- | --- |
| 左键状态面板 | 点窗口芯片弹出面板：会话生效值、当前设定、上游默认值、横向档位、自定义输入框 |
| 右键档位菜单 | 右键芯片弹出与系统右键菜单同款的列表，换档一步到位 |
| 跟随上游 | 档位之一：不写死数值，DSH 使用上游声明的窗口，上游变了就跟着变 |
| 自定义 | 面板输入框直接填任意正整数，上限由上游声明决定 |
| 设置弹窗 | 按提供方 / 模型列出，标出已自定义与已调整档位的模型，可只看已自定义 |
| 批量 | 按提供方一次性应用或恢复，超出上游的模型自动跳过 |
| 界面刷新 | 右键菜单与设置弹窗内置，不关闭客户端即可重载界面 |

窗口值统一以 `K` / `M` 显示；不由 `llm-pi-ai` 管理的路由只显示会话生效值，档位置灰。

## 安装

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-context-presets
```

## 架构

- `src/core` 纯逻辑：档位、设置文档读取、写入计划、菜单条目；
- `src/client` 界面：窗口芯片、右键菜单、设置弹窗，经核心槽位 `conversation.composer.dock` 与 `plugins.bundle.config` 挂载；
- `src/host` 宿主半侧，只占位、不持有状态；
- `build.mjs` 把这些模块内联成浏览器可执行的 `lib/client.js`，`lib/index.js` 是宿主入口。

## 兼容性

DSH ≥ 0.2.0-rc.2，Web 客户端。

## 许可证

MIT

plugins.description: ✨ Prompt enhancement button for the DeepSeek Harness composer — rewrites your rough draft into a clear prompt, in place.
plugins.readme_text: # dsh-prompt-enhance **A ✨ button in the DeepSeek Harness composer that rewrites your rough draft into a clear, well-structured prompt — then puts it straight back into the input box.** Type a half-formed thought, click once, send a well-specified request. No copy-paste, no second window, no leaving the conversation. > Same idea as the "enhance prompt" button in WorkBuddy and similar chat clients, built as a native DSH plugin. --- ## Contents - [What it looks like](#what-it-looks-like) - [Real example](#real-example) - [Why not just retype it](#why-not-just-retype-it) - [Requirements](#requirements) - [Install](#install) - [Configuration](#configuration) - [Usage](#usage) - [How it works](#how-it-works) - [Design decisions](#design-decisions) - [Troubleshooting](#troubleshooting) - [Known limitations](#known-limitations) - [Development notes](#development-notes) - [Project layout](#project-layout) - [Uninstall](#uninstall) - [FAQ](#faq) - [License](#license) --- ## What it looks like A sparkle button appears in the composer toolbar: ``` ┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐ │ Describe the task, type / for commands, @ for files │ │ │ │ [+] [permissions ▾] [✨] [model ▾] [↑] │ │ ↑ │ │ the enhance button │ └─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘ ``` It registers into `conversation.input.right` — a **list** slot immediately left of the model selector. Being a list slot matters: it can coexist with other composer buttons, and it never competes with the voice-input button that owns the neighbouring single-valued `conversation.input.activity` slot. > **Screenshot wanted.** Drop one at `docs/screenshot.png` and it will show here: > `` ### Button states | State | Look | Meaning | |---|---|---| | Idle | Grey ✨ at 75% opacity, brightens on hover | Ready | | Busy | Small spinning ring | Waiting on the model | | Error | ✨ turns red; hover shows the reason | See [Troubleshooting](#troubleshooting) | | Disabled | 45% opacity, no hover response | No session, or a submission is in flight | --- ## Real example Input: ``` 关于 iPhone 多评测的微博，折痕到底是有没有折痕 ``` After clicking ✨: ``` 请基于目前公开的 iPhone 折叠屏评测内容，说明屏幕折痕的实际程度： 折痕是否明显、在哪些角度或光线下可见、与同类产品相比表现如何。 请区分客观测试结论与主观手感描述，并说明信息来源。 ``` Input: ``` 带哦上官金虹感觉看电视呢 ``` After clicking ✨: ``` 请说明上官金虹与看电视这一说法之间的关联，我的表述可能有误， 请先澄清可能的原意，再给出对应解释。 ``` The rewrite keeps your intent and language, fixes garbled text, makes the goal explicit, and adds structure **only when it helps**. It never invents requirements you did not imply, and it never answers the prompt — it only rewrites it. --- ## Why not just retype it Retyping works. This exists for the cases where it doesn't: - **You're thinking out loud.** Voice input, dictation, or a half-finished sentence produces a draft that is right in substance and wrong in form. - **You're on the wrong keyboard.** Switching input methods mid-thought breaks flow. - **You don't know what the agent needs.** A good prompt states the goal, the subject, the constraint, and what "done" looks like. Knowing that helps; writing it every time doesn't. - **Rewrites are cheap and reversible.** The result lands in the draft, not in the send buffer. Edit it, undo it, or ignore it. --- ## Requirements | Requirement | Notes | |---|---| | **DeepSeek Harness** | Desktop app or a web profile. Built against the bundled bundles; no source checkout needed. | | **A working model route** | The plugin calls `ctx.llm.stream()` on an explicitly configured provider/model. Whatever you already chat with will do. | | **`dsh-client-ui-conversation`** | Ships with DSH; declared as the client dependency. | | **`dsh-commands`** | Ships with DSH; the plugin needs the `commands` service. | Nothing else. No build step, no dependencies, no npm packages of its own — the plugin is three source files. --- ## Install ### Step 1 — get the package into your profile ```bash git clone https://github.com/AntMan-xtalgh/dsh-prompt-enhance.git cd dsh-prompt-enhance ``` Then install it into a profile. Replace `desktop` with your profile name if different (`ls ~/.dsh/profiles/`). ```bash dsh plugin --profile desktop add "$(pwd)" ``` If that fails with a pnpm workspace-root error, use the DSH-bundled pnpm directly: ```bash PNPM="/Applications/DeepSeek Harness.app/Contents/Resources/runtime/primary-runtime/dependencies/pnpm/bin/pnpm.cjs" cd "$HOME/.dsh/profiles/desktop" node "$PNPM" add -w "file:/absolute/path/to/dsh-prompt-enhance" ``` > **Use DSH's own pnpm.** A Homebrew or system pnpm with a different store major version fails with > `ERR_PNPM_UNEXPECTED_STORE` because your profile's `node_modules` is linked from pnpm 11's store. ### Step 2 — register the bundle Open `~/.dsh/profiles/desktop/package.json` and add the package to `dsh.profile.bundles`: ```json { "dsh": { "profile": { "bundles": [ "@deepseek-ai/dsh-base", "@deepseek-ai/dsh-web-app", "… your existing bundles …", "dsh-prompt-enhance" ] } } } ``` `pnpm add` puts the package in `dependencies`; this step is what actually tells DSH to load it. ### Step 3 — point it at a model Append to `~/.dsh/profiles/desktop/cordis.patch.yml`: ```yaml - id: prompt-enhance name: "dsh-prompt-enhance" config: provider: moxing model: deepseek-flash-1017 ``` Use the route you already run. If unsure, open the model picker in the composer and read the name — the left part is usually the provider, the right part the model. > The `id` must match the one in this package's `cordis.patch.yml`. That is how a profile-level entry overrides the bundle's inserted row rather than adding a second one. ### Step 4 — restart DSH **Cmd+Q** to quit fully (closing the window does not unload plugins), then relaunch. The ✨ appears left of the model selector. If it does not, see [Troubleshooting](#troubleshooting). ### Verify it loaded ```bash ls ~/.dsh/profiles/desktop/node_modules/dsh-prompt-enhance/ # client.js cordis.patch.yml index.js locale package.json ``` --- ## Configuration All configuration lives in the profile patch from step 3. | Field | Type | Required | Meaning | |---|---|---|---| | `provider` | string | **yes** | Provider route id, e.g. `moxing`, `deepseek-official` | | `model` | string | **yes** | Model id on that route, e.g. `deepseek-flash-1017` | Both must be set together. `ctx.llm.listProviders()` reports provider ids but not their models, and the session's own resolved route is not exposed to plugin code — so this pair cannot be auto-detected. See [Known limitations](#known-limitations). The rewrite instruction is a constant in `index.js` (`SYSTEM_PROMPT`). Fork and edit it if you want a different rewriting policy — for example, always produce English, or always emit a bullet list. --- ## Usage 1. Type anything into the composer — a fragment, a garbled sentence, a rough plan. 2. Click **✨**. 3. Wait a moment. The draft is **replaced in place** with the rewrite. 4. Edit it if you want, then send as usual. Notes: - **The draft is replaced, not appended.** Undo (Cmd+Z) restores the original. - **Multi-line drafts are flattened** for the model call, because a command line may not contain line breaks. Line breaks are collapsed to single spaces, not dropped. - **An empty draft does nothing** except show a short hint. - **The button is per-session.** Each session has its own composer and its own button state. - **Concurrent sends are safe** — if a submission is in flight, the button is disabled rather than racing it. --- ## How it works ``` Client (browser) Host (process) ───────────────── ────────────── ✨ click │ ├─ read document.querySelector('[data-composer-input]').innerText │ ├─ ctx.remote.commands.execute( │ sessionId, │ '/enhance ',
